data.name: Sanatkumar
data.gender_notes: Sanatkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanatkumar is a revered figure in Hindu mythology, often depicted as an immortal sage. The name Sanatkumar carries the meaning “Eternal Youth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sanatkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal youth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the eternal and unchanging nature of wisdom.
data.etymology: Sanatkumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal Youth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanatkumar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
